title: Amazon opens Seller University to all users
description: Amazon announced that Seller University, its educational resource platform for selling on Amazon, is now available to everyone, not just registered sellers. This expansion lowers the barrier to entry by allowing prospects to access training content before committing to selling on the platform.

title: Amazon launches guided brand violation reporting experience
description: Amazon introduced a new unified, guided experience for reporting brand violations, streamlining the process into a single flow. This enhancement supports brand-registered sellers in protecting their intellectual property more efficiently.

title: Amazon offers personalized seller support at Accelerate 2026 via Seller Café
description: Amazon announced a Seller Café activation at its Amazon Accelerate 2026 conference, offering sellers personalized, one-on-one support sessions. This initiative targets engaged sellers looking to resolve specific issues or deepen platform knowledge through direct interaction with Amazon staff.

title: Poshmark sunsets consignment program, acquires Linda's Stuff facilities for luxury resale
description: Poshmark is shutting down its existing consignment model and acquiring the operational facilities of Linda's Stuff to build a purpose-built 'consignment as a service' offering with expert authentication, white-glove intake, and dedicated fulfillment. The infrastructure will be repurposed to service Poshmark sellers listing high-value fashion items. Access will roll out gradually based on facility capacity.

title: Poshmark removes Excessive Listing Removal policy to ease seller inventory management
description: Poshmark is eliminating its Excessive Listing Removal policy, which had previously restricted how sellers could manage their closet inventory, following strong pushback from the seller community. Sellers can now delete and manage listings freely without risk of policy penalties. The change is paired with guidance on optimizing listing quality to maintain sales performance.

title: Poshmark launches new Seller Hub as centralized business management dashboard
description: Poshmark is introducing a redesigned Seller Hub described as the biggest change yet to closet management on the platform, consolidating key actions, performance signals, and growth tools into a single streamlined interface. The hub is designed to surface next-best actions and reduce the operational effort required to run a seller business. The launch is positioned as a foundational UX overhaul for the seller experience.

title: Poshmark overhauling Smart List AI to enable snap-and-list in seconds
description: Poshmark is rolling out a full overhaul of its Smart List AI tool, aiming to let sellers create complete, priced listings from a single photo taken on a mobile device. The updated tool is intended to auto-generate titles, descriptions, and pricing suggestions with minimal seller input. Beta testers are being recruited ahead of the broader release.

title: Poshmark launches performance-based seller recognition program with search visibility rewards
description: Launching in October, Poshmark's new program recognizes sellers who consistently ship fast, fulfill orders, and accurately describe items, granting them elevated search visibility and a buyer-facing trust signal. Qualification requires 20 lifetime orders plus rolling 90-day thresholds on ship time, sales volume, cancellation rate, and return case rate. Buyers will be able to filter search results to shop exclusively from qualifying sellers.

title: Poshmark absorbs USPS hazmat fees through July 2026, then caps seller liability at $5
description: In response to a new USPS $50 hazardous materials non-compliance fee effective July 12, 2026, Poshmark is covering 100% of any flagged fees through July 31 and then 90% (capping seller cost at $5) from August 1 onward. The company is also providing sellers with step-by-step guidance on avoiding the fee by inspecting reused boxes and reviewing electronics shipping requirements. Sellers who believe they were incorrectly charged can escalate to Poshmark Support for review.

title: Depop removes seller fees for Australian market from July 22
description: Depop is eliminating selling fees for all Australia-based sellers effective July 22, mirroring its existing zero-seller-fee model in the UK and US. The move is explicitly aimed at attracting new sellers and increasing listings, with Depop citing a 30–45% increase in listings following similar fee removals in other markets. To offset revenue, Depop is simultaneously introducing a buyer-side marketplace fee of up to 5% plus up to $1 AUD per transaction.

title: Depop commissions research linking resale experience to career value
description: Depop commissioned and exclusively shared research with Fortune showing that 71% of Gen Z sellers say online resale taught them more practical business knowledge than formal education, and that 85% of hiring managers agree resale experience is resume-worthy. The research positions Depop seller activity as a legitimate professional credential, with CEO Peter Semple publicly endorsing the finding. This serves as a brand-led acquisition and engagement campaign targeting Gen Z prospects by reframing selling on Depop as career-building, not just income-generating.

title: Vinted AI moderation causing widespread erroneous seller bans
description: Vinted's automated fraud and counterfeit detection system has been flagging and permanently banning legitimate sellers at scale, with over 1,600 permanent bans logged on a third-party complaints site. The AI appears to misinterpret benign actions such as price changes or relisting low-value second-hand items as fraudulent activity. Vinted states that human review teams handle all appeals, but sellers report receiving only automated responses and facing significant delays or outright failed appeals.

title: Vinted Pay launches in-house wallet for marketplace members
description: Vinted began onboarding members onto its proprietary Vinted Pay wallet solution in 2025. The wallet is designed to reduce payment-related costs and platform dependencies over time, with the long-term goal of lowering transaction costs for sellers and buyers. This infrastructure investment supports retention by making the end-to-end trading experience more seamless and cost-efficient.

title: Vinted Go carrier expands to Spain and Portugal, now in 5 markets
description: Vinted's in-house carrier service, Vinted Go, launched operations in Spain and Portugal in 2025 and opened a new sortation centre in France to handle growing parcel volumes. The carrier network now operates in Belgium, France, the Netherlands, Portugal, and Spain, giving sellers access to over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points across Europe. This expansion reduces seller shipping costs and friction, directly supporting listing and sale conversion.

title: Vinted expands marketplace categories into sports and collectables
description: In 2025, Vinted broadened its marketplace beyond core fashion to include sports goods and collectables, alongside continued strength in women's and kids' clothing. This category expansion attracts new seller segments with different inventory profiles and encourages existing members to list a wider range of items. The move is intended to grow the total addressable second-hand market and increase member engagement.

title: Vinted launches in Latvia, Estonia, and Slovenia to extend European reach
description: Vinted entered three new European markets — Latvia, Estonia, and Slovenia — in 2025, continuing its geographic expansion strategy. New market launches create fresh seller acquisition opportunities by onboarding an entirely new base of prospective C2C sellers. This reflects a deliberate multi-market growth approach tied to Vinted's mission of making second-hand the first choice worldwide.

title: Depop Australia removes seller fees, shifts to buyer marketplace fee
description: From 22 July 2026, Depop is eliminating the 10% selling fee for all Australian-based sellers on AUD sales, replacing it with a buyer-side marketplace fee of up to 5% of item price plus up to $1 AUD. The fee structure change mirrors Depop's UK and US model, where removing seller fees reportedly drove a 30–45% increase in listings. Payment processing and boosting fees continue to apply for sellers.

title: Depop Australia announces dedicated shipping solution for buyers and sellers
description: Depop Australia confirmed that a dedicated shipping solution for both buyers and sellers is planned for the months ahead, representing an investment in the platform's fulfilment infrastructure. This was announced alongside the fee structure changes as part of a broader set of improvements for the Australian market.

title: Poshmark tests streamlined pre-search with repositioned People Search
description: Poshmark is A/B testing a redesigned pre-search experience that moves People Search from a dedicated tab to the bottom of autocomplete suggestions, allowing users to still find profiles and closets by tapping the autocomplete option. The People tab and Posh Ambassador section are temporarily removed from the pre-search page during this test. This change affects how buyers discover sellers and closets organically through search.

title: Vinted zero-fee model drives eBay & Depop to eliminate UK seller fees
description: CMA findings confirm Vinted's free-to-sell model directly prompted eBay to eliminate selling fees for UK private sellers of pre-owned fashion in April 2024, later extending fee-free selling across most private seller categories in October 2024. Depop similarly removed its 10% UK selling fee for new listings in March 2024, shifting monetization to buyers instead. The CMA tied these fee structure changes more directly to Vinted's competitive pressure than the companies acknowledged publicly.

title: Vinted launches in Australia with zero seller fees and integrated shipping
description: Vinted officially launched in Australia on July 1 with a zero seller fee model, integrated payments, and prepaid Australia Post shipping labels. It also established an international shipping corridor connecting Australian and UK users, giving the new market immediate access to Vinted's established UK inventory. The launch triggered Depop to eliminate selling fees for Australian sellers from July 22 and introduce a buyer Marketplace Fee of up to 5%.

title: Vinted ramps up US expansion with New York-focused zero-fee campaign
description: Vinted stepped up its US expansion in January with a New York-focused marketing campaign promoting its zero-seller-fee model, mirroring its European approach. The effort drove an estimated 2.6 million US downloads from January through April, up from just 286,000 in the same period the prior year. Within two months of the announcement, eBay offered invited US sellers zero Final Value Fees on up to 25 sales across key categories including fashion and baby.

title: eBay offers zero Final Value Fee promo to select US sellers amid Vinted threat
description: In March, eBay offered invited US sellers zero Final Value Fees on up to 25 sales in Clothing, Shoes & Accessories, Baby, Home Décor, and Jewelry & Watches categories. The limited promotion came less than two months after Vinted announced its New York expansion, though eBay did not publicly link the two. The move reflects a broader competitive response to Vinted's fee-free seller acquisition strategy in the US market.

title: eBay introduces fee-free selling for small C2C sellers in Australia
description: eBay introduced fee-free selling for eligible Australia-based sellers with A$25,000 or less in eBay sales over the past 12 months, alongside new Buyer Protection Fees and a shipping mandate requiring eBay-purchased labels for eligible items. The move mirrors structural changes eBay made in the UK the prior year and comes as Vinted and Depop both launched or expanded their zero-fee models in Australia. eBay also owns Tise, a secondhand fashion marketplace that expanded into Australia earlier this year.

title: Vinted launches in Australia with Australia Post as exclusive delivery partner
description: Vinted is entering the Australian market on July 1 with a three-year contract naming Australia Post as its sole shipping provider, offering sellers and buyers flexible drop-off and delivery options including post offices, parcel lockers, and home delivery. As part of the partnership, Vinted will also advertise its platform across Australia Post properties via parcel locker wraps, point-of-sale signage, kiosk screens, social media, and television. The launch targets a resale market estimated to reach $6.75 billion by 2029, positioning Vinted to acquire new sellers in a high-growth re-commerce market.

title: Vinted removes seller fees, charges buyers instead to boost inventory
description: After Plantenga took over in 2016, Vinted overhauled its business model by eliminating seller fees entirely, allowing sellers to keep 100% of the listed price while charging buyers a small fee instead. This structural change attracted more inventory, improved marketplace liquidity, and laid the foundation for profitability. The model is cited as a core competitive advantage and a key driver of Vinted's scale across Europe.

title: Vinted enters US market with early-stage testing, reports 6x DAU growth
description: Vinted launched early-stage US market testing in January 2026, entering a competitive landscape against eBay/Depop, Poshmark, Facebook Marketplace, and ThredUp. Wells Fargo analysts noted that Vinted's US daily active users jumped more than six-fold in Q2 2026 compared to the prior year. The company is encouraged by initial results but has declined to share detailed expansion plans.

title: Vinted Go operates 18,000+ pickup/drop-off points to support seller shipping
description: Vinted's in-house logistics arm, Vinted Go, operates more than 18,000 pickup and drop-off points across Europe, including lockers and designated shops. This infrastructure provides sellers with pre-paid shipping solutions directly integrated into the listing-to-sale flow. The logistics network is highlighted as a key competitive differentiator that investors view as a core infrastructure advantage.

title: Mercari splits USPS HAZMAT noncompliance fee with sellers
description: Mercari announced it will absorb half of a new $50 USPS HAZMAT noncompliance fee, leaving affected sellers responsible for only $25. This policy is designed to reduce financial exposure for sellers who inadvertently mislabel packages, softening the impact of an external regulatory cost.

title: Mercari uses shipping discount promotions to drive GMV recovery
description: Mercari credited shipping discount promotions as a meaningful contributor to its fiscal 2026 GMV growth, having offered several temporary discounts on prepaid labels throughout the year. The company is exploring bundle purchases as a strategy for fiscal 2027 to spread shipping costs across multiple items and address the challenge of shipping economics on lower-priced goods.

title: Mercari deploys category-specific CRM marketing to re-engage users
description: Mercari attributed part of its Q4 fiscal 2026 recovery—including a return to positive year-over-year Monthly Active User growth—to category-specific CRM marketing campaigns. The targeted approach focused particularly on Entertainment & Hobbies and fashion, helping drive both buyer re-engagement and transaction volume.

title: Mercari plans AI-assisted small teams to ship US product and UX updates
description: As part of its fiscal 2027 roadmap, Mercari disclosed that smaller AI-assisted product teams will develop new features and improvements to the US marketplace UI and UX. The initiative also includes continued enhancements to customer service and fraud prevention, signaling a leaner, technology-augmented approach to platform development.

title: Etsy allows AI-generated art with disclosure requirement, enforcement lax
description: In 2024, Etsy officially announced it would permit AI-generated art on its platform provided sellers disclose its use, while also banning the sale of custom AI prompts and prohibiting AI used to deceive buyers. However, multiple sellers report the disclosure mandate is not strictly enforced, and complaints about unlabeled AI content go largely unaddressed by Etsy's customer operations team. This policy has driven a measurable exodus of established handmade-goods sellers from the platform.

title: eBay acquires Depop for $1.2bn following CMA clearance
description: The UK's Competition and Markets Authority cleared eBay's $1.2bn acquisition of Depop from Etsy, originally announced in February. The deal gives eBay access to Depop's 3 million active sellers and 7 million active buyers, nearly 90% of whom are under 34, accelerating eBay's C2C and pre-loved fashion strategy. eBay plans to leverage its scale, financial services, shipping solutions, and Authenticity Guarantee to enhance the Depop seller and buyer experience.

title: Vinted launches in Australia with zero seller fees and Australia Post integration
description: Vinted officially entered the Australian market on 1 July 2026, offering a zero-selling-fee model where sellers keep 100% of their earnings. The launch includes a fully integrated shipping and payment flow via a partnership with Australia Post, with prepaid labels issued automatically upon sale and drop-off available any day of the week.

title: Vinted partners with Australia Post for integrated shipping at launch
description: As part of its Australian launch, Vinted embedded Australia Post directly into its app-based shipping flow, enabling sellers to receive prepaid labels automatically when an item sells and drop off parcels at any Australia Post location seven days a week. This removes a key friction point in the seller fulfilment journey for a market-entry audience.

title: Etsy seller base grows 5.9% YoY to 5.7M for second consecutive quarter
description: Etsy reported hosting 5.7 million active sellers in Q2, representing 5.9% year-over-year growth and marking the second consecutive quarter of net seller additions. This comes as the company focuses on its core marketplace and enforces stricter quality standards to weed out mass-produced, generic items. The growth signals improving seller acquisition momentum despite broader competitive pressures from Amazon, TikTok Shop, and Temu.

title: Etsy restructures product & engineering teams to accelerate marketplace innovation
description: Etsy announced a 12% workforce reduction (~220 employees) concentrated in product and engineering, framed not as cost-cutting but as a move to 'move faster and execute with even greater focus' on marketplace growth. CEO Kruti Patel Goyal signaled the restructuring is intended to build organizational capacity for the next phase of growth. This realignment is likely to affect the pace and direction of seller-facing tools and platform feature development.

title: Etsy improves search to surface personalized results and speed up item discovery
description: Etsy made improvements to its on-site search capabilities to deliver more personalized results to buyers and help them discover items faster. Enhanced search visibility directly benefits active sellers by increasing the likelihood their listings surface to relevant shoppers. This is part of a broader effort to differentiate the marketplace and drive GMS growth, which rose 9.3% on the core marketplace in Q2.

title: Etsy launches Etsy Insider beta loyalty program for top buyers
description: Etsy is running a beta program called Etsy Insider, weaving loyalty efforts into personalized recommendations, targeted offers, and enhanced customer support rather than operating a standalone loyalty program. The initiative includes enhanced Purchase Protection and dedicated customer support resolution specifically for top buyers. These structural updates are designed to convert initial engagement into durable repeat purchase behavior.

title: Etsy invests in AI-generated buyer profiles and personalized app feeds
description: Etsy is investing in AI-generated buyer profiles, personalized home feeds, smarter recommendations, and more targeted push communications within its mobile app. Early testing has produced improvements in add-to-cart activity, conversion, and overall engagement. Mobile app GMS rose 11.2% year over year in Q1 2026, accounting for approximately 47% of total GMS.

title: StockX launches AI-powered used/vintage listing feature with zero seller fees
description: StockX introduced 'StockX Listings' on June 24, 2026, expanding its marketplace to include used sneakers and vintage apparel alongside its existing new/deadstock inventory. The feature uses AI photo analysis and proprietary pricing guidance to accelerate the listing process, and initially allows sellers to keep 100% of their sales revenue. The rollout began with a curated seller group and all U.S. iOS buyers, with Android and full U.S. seller access coming in the following months.

title: Vinted partners with ADAD agency for Australian market launch
description: Vinted has appointed independent media agency Advertising Advantage (ADAD) to lead media strategy, planning, and buying for its entry into the Australian market. The partnership aims to build brand awareness, acquire new members, and establish a local community of buyers and sellers. Vinted is also activating a nationwide campaign using Australia Post's owned media network, including Parcel Lockers, to boost awareness of its launch.

title: StockX Live early access launches as new seller channel with marketing support
description: StockX launched early access to StockX Live on July 30, 2026, a live shopping experience available to all U.S. customers on iOS, enabling sellers to run livestreamed auctions starting at $1 for sneakers, apparel, and vintage items. The platform offers sellers dedicated marketing support and a Live team focused exclusively on seller success, alongside access to StockX's existing millions of monthly visitors. To drive seller and buyer adoption, StockX is offering $1 shipping on all Live orders through August 31, 2026, product giveaways, and a curated weekend lineup hosted by influential sellers.

title: Mercari splits new USPS HAZMAT noncompliance fee 50/50 with sellers
description: Beginning September 1, Mercari will absorb half of the new $50 USPS hazardous materials noncompliance fee, leaving sellers liable for $25 when improperly marked packages are flagged. The policy is part of Mercari US's broader effort under new CEO Jeff LeBeau to soften shipping-related costs and strengthen seller confidence without fully absorbing carrier penalties. Mercari is also warning sellers to remove or blot out old HAZMAT labels on reused packaging to avoid triggering the fee.

title: Vinted extends decade-long payments partnership with Mangopay across Europe
description: Vinted has renewed its partnership with Mangopay to continue providing wallet infrastructure, payment processing, and payout capabilities across multiple European markets, operating alongside Vinted's own in-house payment provider, Vinted Pay. The infrastructure supports multi-party payment flows between buyers and sellers at scale. This continuation underpins Vinted's ability to reliably disburse seller payouts as the platform grows, directly supporting seller retention and trust.

title: Vinted extends Royal Mail partnership for 2 years with expanded drop-off/collection network
description: Vinted has renewed its shipping partnership with Royal Mail for a further two years, with Royal Mail expecting to handle double the volume of Vinted parcels. Sellers gain access to an expanded drop-off network including 115,000 postboxes, 1,400 parcel postboxes, and thousands of parcel points, with proof of posting available via the Royal Mail app. Buyers can collect from over 23,700 parcel points including lockers, Royal Mail Shops, Customer Service Points, and Post Office branches.

title: Vinted Go partners with ZigZag to expand OOH returns network across Europe
description: Vinted's logistics brand Vinted Go has formed a strategic partnership with returns specialist ZigZag, giving ZigZag's retail clients access to over 14,000 out-of-home drop-off points across France, the Netherlands, Belgium, Spain, and Portugal. The alliance is designed to drive increased Vinted Go usage through the ZigZag platform while offering retailers a cost-efficient returns channel. This expands Vinted Go's commercial reach by integrating its parcel locker and PUDO network into a third-party returns platform serving mainstream retailers.

title: Depop launches Zara Larsson celebrity campaign and exclusive curated shop
description: Depop partnered with Grammy-nominated pop star Zara Larsson on a four-part cinematic content series designed to showcase how easy it is to discover, buy, and sell fashion on the platform. Alongside the campaign, Depop launched 'The Zara Larsson Edit,' an exclusive shop featuring 20–30 pieces curated from Larsson's personal wardrobe plus upcycled and designer items at attainable price points. The initiative is intended to drive broader audience awareness of Depop's peer-to-peer marketplace and lower the perceived barrier to entry for new buyers and sellers.

title: Depop partners with Spotify to drive discovery via artist storefronts
description: Depop and Spotify launched a co-branded partnership featuring six music artists who curated personal wardrobe storefronts on Depop, linked to exclusive Spotify playlists. The activation included in-app editorial collections, genre-inspired fashion edits, and a two-day physical event in Hollywood to amplify the launch. This continues Depop's strategy of using music industry partnerships to attract culturally engaged sellers and buyers to the platform.

title: Poshmark acquires Linda's Stuff facilities to launch luxury consignment-as-a-service
description: Poshmark is sunsetting its existing consignment program and transitioning to a purpose-built 'consignment as a service' model, backed by the acquisition of Linda's Stuff's dedicated operational facilities. The infrastructure will provide expert authentication, white-glove intake, high-security handling, and specialized fulfillment for high-value fashion items. Access will roll out gradually based on facility capacity, with the stated goal of unlocking high-end seller inventory to attract qualified luxury buyers across the broader marketplace.

title: eBay completes $1.4B acquisition of Depop from Etsy
description: eBay finalized its acquisition of secondhand fashion marketplace Depop on July 30 for approximately $1.4B in cash, including a $1.2B purchase price and $200M in net adjustments and interest. The deal was cleared by UK, Australian, US, and German regulators, removing all major hurdles. Depop is expected to continue operating as a standalone platform under its existing brand, expanding eBay's presence in secondhand fashion and younger consumer demographics.

title: Vinted launches in Australia with free listings and zero seller fees
description: Vinted officially launched in Australia on 1 July 2026, offering free listings where sellers keep all their earnings, attracting a large volume of new sellers and buyers. The platform quickly became one of Australia's most downloaded apps following launch. The fee-free model is explicitly designed to lower barriers for casual sellers and drive rapid seller acquisition.

title: Depop removes Australian selling fees in response to Vinted's launch
description: On 22 July 2026, Depop removed its selling fees for Australian sellers, following Vinted's fee-free entry into the market. This move mirrors eBay's earlier fee removal for Australian sellers in May 2026, indicating competitive pressure from Vinted's expansion is directly driving fee policy changes among incumbent platforms.

title: Depop expands buyer-fee model, eliminates seller commissions in Australia
description: Depop announced plans to eliminate seller commissions in Australia while introducing a new Marketplace Fee charged to buyers, effective July 22. This represents a structural shift in how Depop monetizes transactions, moving the fee burden from sellers to buyers in that market. The change coincides with the removal of PayPal access for Australian users.

title: Depop tests fee-inclusive price display to address transparency concerns
description: Amid a class action over 'drip pricing,' Depop was observed testing an information icon on item pages indicating that the displayed price already includes the Marketplace Fee. This UX change signals a potential move toward upfront fee disclosure at the listing level rather than revealing fees at checkout. The federal class action alleging hidden mandatory fees has since been voluntarily dismissed, with a California state case still pending.

title: Poshmark to cover USPS $50 hazmat non-compliance fee for sellers
description: Starting July 12, 2026, Poshmark will absorb 100% of the new USPS $50 hazardous materials non-compliance fee through July 31, after which sellers will only be charged $5 while Poshmark covers the remaining $45. The policy applies to items complying with Poshmark's terms of service and is designed to protect sellers who may be wrongly flagged, particularly those reusing packaging with old hazmat markings. Poshmark will notify affected sellers via email and deduct the $5 from their redeemable balance, with automatic correction if the balance goes negative.

title: Vinted partners with DHL Germany to expand parcel locker shipping network
description: Vinted has launched a strategic partnership with DHL Group in Germany, enabling sellers and buyers to use DHL's 41,000 parcel drop-off and collection points—including Packstations, Poststations, and DeinFach lockers—for 24/7 peer-to-peer shipping. The integration removes registration barriers: sellers can drop off parcels at Packstations without prior sign-up, and buyers receive collection codes via email (with future in-app delivery). The partnership follows a completed multi-month pilot and positions frictionless shipping as a key lever for growing Vinted's seller and buyer base in Germany.

title: Facebook Marketplace launches dedicated 'Seller' app for US sellers
description: Meta launched 'Seller', a standalone iOS app purpose-built for active Facebook Marketplace sellers in the US (18+), consolidating listing management, a unified buyer inbox, inventory management, and performance insights in one dedicated space. The app features Meta AI-powered listing creation that auto-generates titles, descriptions, price suggestions, and categories from uploaded photos, plus a bulk listing tool. Listings and selling history sync automatically with Facebook Marketplace, meaning sellers can manage their business from the new app while their items remain visible to Marketplace buyers.

title: Poshmark retires Excessive Listing Removal Policy effective July 23
description: Poshmark announced during a seller webinar that its controversial Excessive Listing Removal Policy, introduced in May 2025, will be retired effective July 23, allowing sellers to delete listings without risking account penalties or restrictions. The policy had caused significant friction for cross-listing sellers who needed to remove sold inventory from Poshmark after items sold on other platforms like eBay, Mercari, and Depop. Its retirement comes after more than a year of seller complaints, enforcement errors, automated warnings, and account suspensions.

title: Poshmark launches performance-based seller recognition program with search visibility rewards
description: Poshmark is introducing a new performance-based recognition program that grants qualifying sellers increased visibility in search results, rolling out to buyers as a filter starting this fall. To qualify, sellers must have at least 20 lifetime shipped sales and, over a rolling 90-day period, meet thresholds including five shipped orders or $500 in sales, an average shipping time of two days or less, a cancellation rate no higher than 2%, and an approved return case rate of 2% or less. The program operates alongside the existing Posh Ambassador designation rather than replacing it.

title: Vinted Go launches 'Rescued Value' program to relist undeliverable parcels
description: In November 2025, Vinted Go launched a pilot called 'Rescued Value' across 10 European countries, relisting undeliverable or unrecoverable packages on Vinted through a dedicated account. More than 100,000 products have already found new owners through the program, with revenue covering operational costs of collecting, processing, and reselling items. The software developed for this program is also enabling Vinted Go to build new tools allowing charities to sell donated items on Vinted at scale.

title: Depop scraps 10% seller fees in Australia from July 22
description: Following eBay's $1.7 billion acquisition of Depop, the platform announced it will remove its flat 10% selling fee for all Australian listings effective July 22, bringing Australia in line with the zero-seller-fee model already in place in the US and UK. Sellers will only continue to pay Stripe's payment processing fee of 2.6% of sale price plus $0.03 per transaction. The change was communicated directly to sellers via email, with a prompt to update the app before the effective date.

title: eBay acquires Depop for ~$1.4B to compete in secondhand fashion
description: eBay completed its acquisition of Depop from Etsy on July 30 for approximately $1.4 billion, gaining access to roughly 7 million active buyers, nearly 90% under age 34, and approximately $1 billion in annual GMV. The acquisition gives eBay a dedicated platform to compete in secondhand fashion against Vinted and to reach younger demographics it has struggled to attract on its core marketplace. eBay expects Depop to become accretive to non-GAAP operating income in 2028, implying significant near-term investment and dilution.

title: eBay eliminates private seller fees in Germany and UK in response to Vinted
description: eBay removed private seller fees in Germany and the UK as a direct competitive response to Vinted's pressure on its fee model. To offset the lost revenue, eBay subsequently introduced buyer fees and managed shipping programs in those markets. This represents a structural policy shift in eBay's monetization approach for casual and private sellers in key European markets.

title: eBay tests zero final value fee promotions in US fashion and other categories
description: eBay has run zero final value fee promotional offers for select sellers in US fashion, Baby, and Home Decor categories as competition from Vinted intensifies. The promotions are targeted at specific seller segments and categories most exposed to Vinted's competitive push. This signals eBay is willing to sacrifice short-term fee revenue to retain sellers and GMV in vulnerable categories.

title: Depop running marketing spend at ~3x Vinted's elevated level to drive growth
description: Wells Fargo estimated that Depop's July marketing outlay was running at three times Vinted's already-elevated spending level, with Citizens projecting Depop could spend more than $250 million on marketing in the current year, up from $119 million in 2025. Depop recorded $42 million in marketing expense in Q1 alone, raising analyst concerns about whether growth is being organically driven or purchased through advertising. The sustained high spend is eBay's primary lever to grow Depop's buyer and seller base ahead of its 2028 accretion target.

title: Poshmark absorbs USPS $50 hazmat fee through July 31, splits cost after
description: In response to a new USPS $50 hazardous materials non-compliance fee effective July 12, 2026, Poshmark announced it will cover 100% of the fee for any package postmarked through July 31, 2026, so sellers pay nothing. Starting August 1, 2026, sellers are responsible for only $5 while Poshmark covers the remaining $45, and sellers are notified via email with the charge deducted from their redeemable balance.

title: Depop launches Depop Balance wallet for U.S. sellers
description: Depop announced a gradual rollout of its Depop Balance wallet feature to U.S. sellers beginning March 29, 2026, powered by Stripe Treasury. The wallet allows sellers to hold and reuse funds earned from sales for purchases on the platform, supporting a sell-to-buy flywheel effect. Sellers must complete KYC verification via Stripe and can withdraw balances to their bank account at any time.

title: Depop runs flat-rate $1.99 shipping promo in U.S. Northeast
description: Depop launched a time-limited shipping promotion offering flat-rate $1.99 shipping on orders under 10 lbs. using Depop Shipping, initially targeting buyers and sellers in New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut from March 9 to May 7. The promo was extended to U.S. buyers outside those states purchasing from Northeast sellers starting March 23, covering both single-item and bundle orders.

title: StockX Listings launches used/vintage marketplace with early traction data
description: StockX launched StockX Listings on June 24, a new marketplace for used sneakers, vintage apparel, and accessories, marking an expansion beyond its authenticated new-product model. In its first weeks, the platform recorded thousands of sales across nearly 3,000 unique products and 200 brands, with top-selling sneakers priced 24–31% below equivalent new pairs on StockX's Verified marketplace. This is the first Big Facts report to include data from Listings, signaling StockX is actively promoting the channel to attract a new segment of sellers dealing in used and vintage goods.

title: eBay completes acquisition of Depop fashion resale marketplace
description: eBay has completed its acquisition of Depop, a C2C fashion marketplace with a highly-engaged Gen Z and Millennial user base, representing a strategic expansion into circular fashion resale. Depop will operate as a complementary business retaining its distinct brand and platform, while gaining access to eBay's infrastructure including shipping, personalization, compliance, and trusted services. The deal extends eBay's seller reach to the next generation of fashion resellers and strengthens its position in fashion, already a $10B+ annual GMV category.

title: Poshmark acquires Linda's Stuff facilities to launch 'consignment as a service' model
description: Poshmark has acquired the dedicated operational facilities of Linda's Stuff to sunset its community-powered consignment program and transition to a centralized 'consignment as a service' model with expert authentication, white-glove intake, high-security handling, and dedicated fulfillment. The new program is designed to unlock high-end closets and attract qualified luxury buyers to the platform. Specific details on eligibility, fees, and launch timing have not yet been disclosed.

title: Linda's Stuff moves live shopping and selling operations from eBay to Poshmark
description: Linda's Stuff, one of eBay's largest fashion sellers and its former exclusive US luxury handbag consignment partner, has migrated its entire selling and live shopping operations to Poshmark. The seller had grown eBay Live revenue from 3% to 44% of total revenue before the move. This represents a significant acquisition of an established high-volume seller and live commerce operator for Poshmark.

title: Poshmark acquires eBay Consignment facility, disrupting service
description: Rival Poshmark acquired the facilities of the third-party company that powered eBay's Consignment service, causing eBay Consignment to display an error page. This effectively disrupts eBay's consignment-based seller acquisition channel, which targeted sellers who preferred a hands-off selling experience. The development represents a competitive move by Poshmark to undercut eBay's efforts to onboard low-effort sellers.

title: eBay acquires Depop from Etsy for $1.4 billion
description: eBay completed its acquisition of C2C fashion marketplace Depop from Etsy, paying $1.4 billion. eBay has vowed to operate Depop as a complementary platform while seeking synergies, signaling a multi-platform seller ecosystem strategy. This opens a new acquisition and retention channel targeting fashion-focused sellers on Depop.

title: Amazon enforces new 75-character product title policy on all listings
description: Amazon began enforcing a policy limiting product titles to 75 characters or less, initially effective July 26, 2026, later extended to August 3rd. The policy applies to both third-party seller listings and Amazon's own listings. Sellers with non-compliant titles are required to update them, impacting listing quality workflows.

title: USPS raises Ground Advantage rates affecting marketplace sellers
description: USPS increased Ground Advantage rates effective July 25, 2026, with eBay warning sellers on the Friday prior. eBay communicated the rate change directly to its seller base, highlighting the cost impact on shipping. This affects seller margins and may influence listing pricing and fulfillment decisions across marketplace sellers.

title: Amazon introduces new mandatory handling-time rule for seller-fulfilled orders
description: Amazon's new handling-time rule took effect June 29, 2026, requiring sellers who do not enable the Automated Handling Time feature to maintain specific manual handling-time commitments. The rule was announced on May 27th and impacts seller-fulfilled order workflows. Sellers must either adopt the automated feature or ensure compliance with updated standards.

title: Etsy expands listing-level appeals for policy violations
description: Etsy announced plans to expand listing-level appeals, which are currently limited to violations of its Creativity Standards, to cover broader listing policy violations. The goal is to provide sellers with a wider ability to contest individual listing removals rather than only account-level decisions. This is a seller trust and retention initiative aimed at reducing friction from enforcement actions.

title: Amazon opens holiday deal submissions to sellers starting July 8
description: Amazon allowed sellers to begin submitting holiday deals starting July 8, 2026, with earlier deadlines than prior years. The company provided eligibility criteria and submission guidelines to help sellers participate in holiday promotional events. This is part of Amazon's seasonal seller engagement and sales-driving program.

title: eBay absorbs USPS July rate change impact for lightweight packages via eBay Labels
description: eBay told sellers that eBay Labels would shield them from the impact of a USPS July 12 rate change on Ground Advantage lightweight packages, providing a reprieve on increased costs. This demonstrates eBay using its negotiated shipping rates as a retention lever to keep sellers on its platform-managed label system. The move differentiates eBay's shipping offering from sellers managing postage independently.

title: eBay launches AI-powered product listing tool from photos
description: eBay rolled out a tool that automatically generates product listings from seller-submitted photos, reducing the manual effort required to create listings. This AI-assisted feature is designed to lower the barrier for sellers to get items live on the platform quickly. The tool directly addresses friction in the listing creation process for both new and existing sellers.
